name: Coins
description: A burst of spinning 🪙 gold coins that fly out from the pinch, turning slowly, and fade over about a second. Drawn by code (src/effects/coins.js).

name: Brightness
description: A large point of warm white light that flares at the index fingertip with a flash ring and crossing light streaks, shines for about 2 s and fades out by about 3 s, following the finger as it moves. Drawn by code (src/effects/illumination.js).

name: Fireball
description: A ball of fire forms at the palm and rushes towards the camera, growing as it comes, then bursts into flames and embers (about 2 s). Red, orange and yellow light drawn by code (src/effects/fireball.js).

name: Clock
description: A gothic clock face with Roman numerals and ornate brass hands appears above the middle fingertip. The hands spin fast, then slow down tick by tick until they stop, with time-bending ripples, and it fades out (about 4.4 s). Drawn by code (src/effects/clock.js).

name: Sprout
description: The index finger turns into a branch: bark creeps up from the knuckle to the fingertip, the branch grows on past the tip, then a green shoot opens two leaves with a bud between them and specks of green light (about 5 s). Drawn along the finger, so it moves and bends with it. Drawn by code (src/effects/sprout.js).
